cands.name: Danny Alvarez
cands.bio: Republican attorney (family law) from Riverview, first elected 2022; Chair of the Criminal Justice Subcommittee. Son of Cuban immigrants, Army infantry officer commissioned in 1997, General Counsel for the Tampa Police Benevolent Association.

record.text: House lead on Florida Farm Bills (HB 433 in 2026, passed in Senate form as SB 290; the 2025 package HB 651, which drew national attention for ending fluoride in public water). Co-sponsored the commercial service airports bill (HB 919), which became law.
His campaign site says he is General Counsel for the Tampa Police Benevolent Association and taught business law at the University of Tampa for nearly nine years.

endorsements.text: Sheriffs Chad Chronister (Hillsborough), Bob Gualtieri (Pinellas), Wayne Ivey (Brevard), Grady Judd (Polk), Chris Nocco (Pasco).

cands.gaps: No 2026 campaign-finance reporting found. No controversies found. Owner-source search (Stew Peters / Alex Jones / Owen Shroyer) was NOT run: the shared web-search budget was exhausted, so no owner-source status is known.

votes.what: Joint resolution putting Amendment 3 (Save Our Homes property-tax changes: higher homestead exemption, lower assessment-increase limits) on the Nov 2026 ballot.
The 2025-26 General Appropriations Act (state budget), final vote.
Immigration enforcement bill from the 2025 special session: state cooperation with federal immigration enforcement.
Post-hurricane emergency management bill that also limits local governments' ability to adopt stricter development rules after storms.
Online Protections for Minors: restricts social media accounts for minors.
Interests of foreign countries: restricts land purchases near military sites and critical infrastructure by people from China and other 'countries of concern'.
Education: expands school voucher eligibility to all Florida K-12 students.
Heartbeat Protection Act: bans most abortions after six weeks of pregnancy.
Public Safety: lets most adults carry a concealed firearm without a permit (permitless carry).
Property Insurance: creates the Florida Optional Reinsurance Assistance program (FORA) for insurers.
